description: Benchmark variants of a web page in a fresh headless Chromium (needs Playwright in the project). Each case is a path + query params on a running app; each run loads a fresh page, waits until ready, then records frame rate, frame gaps, long tasks, Long Animation Frames (with script names), layout shifts, DOM size, and Chrome's own main-thread, script, style and layout time. Cases run in rounds with the order shuffled each round. `cpuSlowdown` repeats everything with Chrome's CPU throttled (e.g. [1, 4, 6]) as a stand-in for slower phones; it doesn't slow the GPU. Blocks until done.

allowPageErrors.description: Keep runs whose page threw an uncaught error. Default false: such runs fail.

budgets.description: Hard limits. The report says which cases meet all of them; an unmeasured limit counts as not met.

cases.description: Variants to compare. The first is the baseline.

control.description: Does different work (e.g. an empty page). Shown, never the baseline or a candidate.

extraRoundsWhenClose.description: If the two smoothest cases are too close to call, run up to this many extra rounds of just those two. Default 0.

headed.description: Show the browser window. Default false.

maxBatchMs.description: Stop starting new runs after this long. Default 30 minutes.

outFile.description: Also save the full result and options as JSON here, to read again later.

projectRoot.description: Folder to load Playwright from. Default: the server's working directory.

readySelector.description: CSS selector that must appear before a run counts as ready.

settleMs.description: Wait after the page is ready, before recording. Default 1000.

steps.description: Real input during each run, in order: {click: selector}, {press: key}, {type: {selector, text}}, {scroll: px}, {wait: ms}, {expect: {selector, text?}} (checked after the run; fails runs that skipped the work). Click targets are located before recording and must not move. Adds input delay, handler time and time to next paint per case.

traceDir.description: Save one Chrome trace per case here (extra, unranked runs). Needs Buoy Pro.

url.description: Origin of the running app, e.g. http://localhost:5173

name: run_web_benchmark
